rules.body: Apply when deferred edits belong to a persistent shared buffer while a view owns only observation. README.md states: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." docs/host-api.md states: "Document buffers are owned by the store BufferBank, while Badge owns only a live subscription." Preserve those separate ownership lifetimes.

Route edits through the existing document buffer's trailing task. Replace pending text and restart the quiet interval on each edit; save the latest text once after 120 ms of quiet, and keep the task reusable for later bursts. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save."

On open, close, or dispose, detach the departing badge's subscription and complete its pending document persistence before returning. Flush the captured departing buffer without destroying the store-owned buffer or discarding its pending edits. This preserves persistence when introducing deferral: TASK states "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." The original src/workflow.php edit path writes immediately: "function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$this->env->write($view->id,$text);}}"

Treat flushing as a synchronous reentry boundary. Clear the departing current view before invoking callbacks, and recheck the navigation generation after retirement before an outer open installs its requested view. Nested navigation must remain authoritative. docs/host-api.md states: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/workflow.php already supplies the guard: "function open($id){$request=++$this->generation;$this->retire();if(true&&$request!==$this->generation)return;"

Preserve the existing trailing task's clearing of pending state before invoking work, including acceptance of empty text and reuse after flushing. src/workflow.php states: "$value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;\n        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);" Preserve the document identity captured by the buffer callback: "new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);})". docs/host-api.md requires: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics."

Keep preview ownership and cancellation unchanged. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.php specifies "new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}" Therefore document departure flushing must not replace preview hide cancellation.

Verify no write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write at expiry, subsequent bursts, and empty text. Verify pending persistence before open/close/dispose returns, correct document identity on reopening, subscription cleanup, and synchronous save listeners that open another document or close the workspace. Verify preview retains its 40 ms delay, discards pending output on hide, and accepts later queries. These checks exercise the task and source obligations above; evaluation observations do not add requirements.

limitations: Applies to persistent document buffers with synchronous store callbacks; transient work may require cancellation instead of flushing.
Exception handling and callbacks from already-cancelled timers are unspecified.
Multiple workspaces sharing one document buffer are not fully specified.
Attempt 1 supplies supporting observations only. One passing attempt establishes neither causality nor cross-task benefit.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
